name: Out of Tune
source:
IN THE NOT SO DISTANT 2006...

two young boys meet during university and find out they have a lot in common: their name is Andrej Feline and David Hound. It's hard to spend time together in a post-yugoslav society, but they work hard to maintain this fairytale type of romance.

although, they're soon to realize that having a relationship isn't easy, and that they'll have to get over their struggles and insecurities if they wanna make sure the harmony of their love doesn't fall appart...but no promises.

[From [url=https://bluebearryz.itch.io/out-of-tune]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在不久的2006年……

两个小男孩在大学期间相遇，发现他们有很多共同点：他们的名字叫安德烈·菲林 (Andrej Feline) 和大卫·猎犬 (David Hound)。在后南斯拉夫社会中很难共度时光，但他们努力维持这种童话般的浪漫。

不过，他们很快就会意识到建立一段关系并不容易，如果他们想确保他们的爱情不会破裂，就必须克服挣扎和不安全感……但没有承诺。

[来自[url=https://bluebearryz.itch.io/out-of-tune]Itch.io[/url]]
